newsitem.title: USA: U.S. brass mill copper stocks lower in Oct - ABMS.
newsitem.headline: U.S. brass mill copper stocks lower in Oct - ABMS.

text.p: U.S. brass mill copper stocks fell to 141,900 short tons (copper content) at the end of October from 143,000 short tons in September, the American Bureau of Metal Statistics said.
Scrap consumption was 37,500 short tons in the month, down from a September tally of 57,400 short tons.

Refinery shapes consumption was 39,900 tons in October against 38,000 the previous month. Total brass mill shipments rose to 104,200 short tons from 99,900 in September. Total receipts were 103,100 short tons in October, up from September's 97,400 short tons.
